description: This file defines the interface for the internal functions of the ALCert implementation, including functions for managing certificates, Certificate Authority (CA) entities, certificate chains, verification, loading/saving certificates, and CRL updates. It contains function prototypes and documentation comments, but no actual implementations.

methods.name: ALCERTRemoveCAEntity
methods.description: Removes a CA entity based on the handle and flags.

methods.name: ALCERTRemoveClientEntity
methods.description: Removes a client entity based on its handle.

methods.name: ALCERTRemoveCRL
methods.description: Removes a CRL associated with an entity.

methods.name: ALCERTGetCACount
methods.description: Returns the total number of CA certificates.

methods.name: ALCERTGetClientCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of client certificates.

methods.name: ALCERTGetCACertByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a CA certificate by its index.

methods.name: ALCERTGetCAEntityByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a CA entity by its index.

methods.name: ALCERTGetClientByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a client entity by its index.

methods.name: ALCERTAddSubjectWithCert
methods.description: Adds a subject with certificate, encoding provided.

methods.name: ALCERTAddSubjectEntity
methods.description: Adds a subject entity to the system.

methods.name: ALCERTSetSubjectCert
methods.description: Sets a certificate for a subject entity.

methods.name: ALCERTAddTrustedCA
methods.description: Adds a trusted CA certificate.

methods.name: ALCERTAddCRL
methods.description: Adds a CRL to an entity.

methods.name: ALCERTSearchCAEntityByEncoding
methods.description: Searches for a CA entity with a specific encoding.

methods.name: ALCERTSearchUserByEncoding
methods.description: Searches for a user entity with a specific encoding.

methods.name: ALCERTSearchCAByName
methods.description: Searches for a CA by its name.

methods.name: ALCERTSearchEntityByName
methods.description: Searches for an entity by its name.

methods.name: ALCERTLookforIssuerEntity
methods.description: Finds the issuer entity for a given certificate.

methods.name: ALCERTVerifyCert
methods.description: Verifies a certificate with a given path index.

methods.name: ALCERTRemoveAllCAs
methods.description: Removes all CA certificates.

methods.name: ALCERTRemoveAllClients
methods.description: Removes all client certificates.

methods.name: ALCERTVerifyCertChain
methods.description: Verifies a chain of certificates.

methods.name: ALCERTAcquirePath
methods.description: Obtains the certificate path for a client entity.

methods.name: ALCERTGetCertChainPath
methods.description: Gets the length of the certificate chain for a subject.

methods.name: ALCERTLookforCAInPath
methods.description: Finds a CA in a certificate path by index.

methods.name: ALCERTLookforEntityWithIssuerName
methods.description: Searches for an entity by issuer name.

methods.name: ALCERTLookforEntityWithKeyType
methods.description: Searches for an entity by key type.

methods.name: ALCERTLookforEntityWithPubKey
methods.description: Searches for an entity with the same public key as a given certificate.

methods.name: ALCERTLoad
methods.description: Loads certificates from storage.

methods.name: ALCERTSave
methods.description: Saves certificates to storage.

methods.name: ALCERTGetCertStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a certificate.

methods.name: RetrieveNameEncoding
methods.description: Extracts the name encoding from a certificate.

methods.name: ALCERTUpdateCACrl
methods.description: Updates the CRL for a given CA.
